materials.title: P vs NP — Clay Mathematics Institute
materials.why_relevant: External status baseline; P vs NP remains open.

materials.title: A Knowledge Compilation Map — Darwiche & Marquis
materials.why_relevant: Succinctness vs polynomial queries/transformations; representation firewall.

materials.title: Effective Preprocessing in SAT Through Variable and Clause Elimination — Eén & Biere
materials.why_relevant: Resolution-based existential elimination and bounded-growth preprocessing.

materials.title: Knowledge Compilation for Model Counting: Affine Decision Trees — Koriche et al.
materials.why_relevant: Affine-aware compilation; ECNF/EADT control.

materials.title: Existential Closures for Knowledge Compilation — Marquis
materials.why_relevant: Hidden-existential firewall.

materials.title: Disjunctive Closures for Knowledge Compilation — Fargier & Marquis
materials.why_relevant: AFF[∨] and related closure-language trade-offs.

materials.title: A Strongly Exponential Separation of DNNFs from CNF Formulas — Bova et al.
materials.why_relevant: Blocks ordinary equivalent DNNF as universal polynomial target.

materials.title: On Limits of Symbolic Approach to SAT Solving — SAT 2024
materials.why_relevant: OBDD(AND,EXISTS,reordering) exponential lower bounds.
materials.anti_loop: Neighboring-model control only; no transfer to general AIG without simulation theorem.

materials.title: Short Definitions in Constraint Languages — Bulín & Kompatscher
materials.why_relevant: Strongest positive algebraic control: few subpowers / edge polymorphisms.
materials.blocker: Required mixed Boolean core lacks one common tractable polymorphism.

materials.title: A New Algorithm for CSPs with Few Subpowers Templates — Delić & El-Aooiti
materials.why_relevant: Constructive tractability method donor.

materials.title: Automatic Constraints with Few Subpowers and Graphoid Recognition — Kalampakas
materials.why_relevant: Compact full-solution representations and projections under a common edge operation.

materials.title: CSPs with Few Alien Constraints — Jonsson, Lagerkvist, Osipov
materials.blocker: Parameterized/scoped; unbounded interaction not universal D1.

materials.title: Recognition of q-Horn Formulae in Linear Time — Boros, Hammer, Sun
materials.why_relevant: Linear recognition + tractable SAT control.
materials.blocker: Closure/expressibility does not guarantee polynomial projected size.

materials.title: One Head is Better than Two — Liberatore
materials.why_relevant: Concrete polynomial-forgetting invariant.
materials.blocker: Too narrow for arbitrary mixed CNF/affine universality.

materials.title: Satisfiability of Acyclic and Almost Acyclic CNF Formulas — Ordyniak, Paulusma, Szeider
materials.why_relevant: Beta-acyclic polynomial elimination; DP-simplicial membership/order discovery hard.

materials.title: Satisfiability of Mixed Horn Formulas — Porschen & Speckenmeyer
materials.why_relevant: Tractable Horn + tractable 2-CNF mixture can still be NP-complete.

materials.title: On the induced problem for fixed-template CSPs — Rustem Takhanov
materials.why_relevant: Turns instance-specific algebra assignment into an explicit induced CSP Gamma^B and separates prototype discovery from solving with a supplied prototype.
materials.blocker: Prototype discovery can remain as hard as the original CSP; coverage and tractability of Gamma^B must both be proved.

materials.title: An Algebraic Approach to Multi-sorted Constraints — Bulatov & Jeavons
materials.why_relevant: Shows that different variables/sorts may use different operation interpretations while one multi-sorted polymorphism preserves each relation; combines tractable single-domain mechanisms.
materials.blocker: Does not provide universal coverage of arbitrary 3-CNF or polynomial discovery of a suitable multi-sorted structure.

materials.title: Domain permutation reduction for constraint satisfaction problems — Green & Cohen
materials.why_relevant: Exact instance-specific transformation: choose one domain permutation per variable so the transformed relations enter a tractable language; discovery itself becomes a lifted CSP.
materials.blocker: Permutation discovery is tractable only for some target classes/domains and can itself be intractable.

materials.title: The Dichotomy for Conservative Constraint Satisfaction is Polynomially Decidable — Carbonnel
materials.why_relevant: Positive control that nontrivial algebraic tractability certificates and their coloured graph can sometimes be recognized in polynomial time.
materials.blocker: Recognition theorem is scoped to conservative CSPs; it does not make arbitrary 3-SAT conservative/tractable.

materials.title: Asking the metaquestions in constraint tractability — Chen & Larose
materials.why_relevant: Hardness control for polymorphism discovery: several metaproblems, including conditions associated with tractability/bounded width, are NP-complete.
materials.blocker: A tractability certificate is not useful for D1 unless the certificate itself is polynomially constructible.

materials.title: The Meta-Problem for Conservative Mal'tsev Constraints — Carbonnel
materials.why_relevant: Positive control where a conservative Mal'tsev polymorphism can be found in polynomial time and then used by a uniform tractable algorithm.
materials.blocker: Conservative scope; does not cover the full hard Boolean 3-SAT template.

materials.title: A Simple Algorithm for Mal'tsev Constraints — Bulatov & Dalmau
materials.why_relevant: Canonical compact-representation algorithm: maintain polynomial generating representations of successive solution relations, generalizing Gaussian elimination.
materials.blocker: Requires a common Mal'tsev polymorphism; arbitrary 3-CNF lacks that invariant.

materials.title: Absorbing Subalgebras, Cyclic Terms, and the Constraint Satisfaction Problem — Barto & Kozik
materials.why_relevant: Structural decomposition donor: absorption and cyclic/Taylor terms explain recursive domain reduction mechanisms used in tractable CSP theory.
materials.blocker: Applies when the fixed template has Taylor structure; Boolean 3-SAT template does not.

materials.title: A simplified proof of the CSP Dichotomy Conjecture and XY-symmetric operations — Zhuk
materials.why_relevant: Mechanism donor for general tractable finite-domain CSPs: strong subalgebras and linear congruences, with a simplified proof of the tractable-side algorithm.
materials.blocker: Still presupposes a tractable/Taylor template; does not supply a lift from arbitrary 3-SAT.

materials.title: Effectiveness of Structural Restrictions for Hybrid CSPs — Kolmogorov, Rolinek & Takhanov
materials.why_relevant: Formal lifted-language construction combining structural restrictions on instances with algebraic restrictions on templates.
materials.blocker: Characterizes scoped hybrid restrictions rather than giving unrestricted SAT tractability.
